title_zh: 请求处理租车后窗故障

scenario.label_zh: 租车期间发现后窗问题并提出换车请求
scenario.goal_zh: 说明租车后窗问题并约定由客服询问换车安排

context_zh: 虚构租车服务练习。顾客 Bea 已将车辆停在租车点停车场，向客服 Omar 报告问题。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: My rental began this morning, but the rear window won't close.

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: Are you still in our car park?

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: Yes, beside the returns desk. Could I have a replacement?

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: I'll ask the fleet team what is available. I can't confirm another car until they check.

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: All right. I'll wait here rather than start my trip.

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: I'll come to the desk with an update as soon as they've answered.
